messages:
Iris: follow-up from today's infra Q&A  short thread to capture decisions and next steps about queueing, fallbacks, and handoff notes.

Ben: echoing product teams  what's the default behavior when a region is near capacity: soft-queue, immediate failover, or degrade model?

Maya: default flow = soft-queue (tiered timeouts) -> degrade model variant if allowed -> route to fallback region -> 429 if all else fails. tiered timeouts: 5s dev, 20s standard, 60s enterprise.

Sana: are fallback decisions latency-aware? we've had concerns about user-facing lag when routed far away.

Maya: yes  router uses latency + cost heuristics. fallback chosen only if latency delta < 50ms or customer enabled `allow_latency_tradeoff`. otherwise we prefer closer region or degrade model.

CS_Rae: support needs a one-liner to tell customers about cross-region routing and billing impact.

Maya: one-liner: "If requests route to another region due to capacity, tokens are billed at the region that served them; pin routes or set `fallback_policy:none` to avoid cross-region routing." we'll post this to #customer-success.

Ben: handoff ask: can infra post a per-region GPU snapshot for tomorrow's morning shift? oncall needs counts + buffer targets.

infra-bot: scheduled: region snapshot will be posted to #eng-oncall at 08:30 PST by @Iris.

Iris: yes I'll post JSON with available GPUs, buffer %, and autoscaler thresholds.

Sana: action on quantization fallbacks? product asked for safe mappings to reduce mem pressure during failovers.

Maya: Optimize team will publish safe fallback mappings (8bit -> 4bit profiles) and a recommended policy `auto_quantize: true` that can be opted in per-route. ETA EOW.

Ben: last thing  can we make queue time available to apps? helpful for UX.

Maya: exposing `x-rw-queue-time` header next week; console will also show a per-route queue-time metric.

Iris: my action items: 1) post region snapshot tomorrow, 2) add compact handoff note to runbook, 3) coordinate FRA canary calendar entry with product. tagging @Maya.

Maya: I'll share quantization doc and the one-liner for support.

Ben: ack  I'll update teams about routing latency budget.

Sana: ack. :eyes:

CS_Rae: :white_check_mark:
